summary: Samantha Voix v2: brain turns are Companion-owned (immediate local waiting phrase), a closed list of social reflexes is answered by the voice itself, run steps come from the agent's user-oriented progress card, and every voice turn logs its measured durations.

routes.change: reflexes answered without Graph call (optional); model-only turns Companion-owned (voiceFastPath execute, owner samantha_brain)
routes.budget: reflex: local only; otherwise unchanged (one resolver call)

routes.change: timing and one bounded log line per turn
live gateway run reads the session progress card (progressCard.get) with a 1.5 s single-flight cache and 1.5 s timeout
routes.budget: + at most one Gateway read per 1.5 s per session, never per list row

capability_impact.detail: No capability added or changed. Reflexes execute nothing; deterministic and executable voice routes, payment included, are unchanged.

architecture_impact.reason: Voice turn ownership moves to the Companion for brain turns; the OpenClaw progress card becomes the source of run steps. Existing owners only: no new store, router, scheduler or retry.

mcp_parity.detail: No MCP tool or adapter change.

rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy the Companion with companion-deploy.sh; no app change.
